newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MANILA'S PHIBOR FALL IN ALL MATURITIES.
newsitem.headline: MANILA'S PHIBOR FALL IN ALL MATURITIES.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) skidded across the board on Thursday in line with the two percentage-point cut in the central bank's overnight borrowing rate to 18 percent, traders said.
Banks also adjusted their swap rates because of the liquidity in the system.
"The market is relatively liquid despite the two percentage points increase in liquidity reserves," a trader said.
The central bank last week raised liquidity reserves to four percent of banks' deposits and trust funds to mop up pesos that may have been shifted to peso speculation.
